title: Akbar Teriyan Rehwaan Takdi Rehndi
body:
Akbar teriyan rahwaa’n takdi rehndi aay Sughra.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Deeway baal kay sochdi rehndi muk na jawan saah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Daswee da din aa geya veeran hijar tera hun kha geya veeran
Ya ghar wapis aa ja Akbar ya tu kol bula..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teray baaj main gee nahin sakdi her pal teriyan rahwaa’n takdi
Asghar day main kurtay chumdi bhaij koi itlaa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jandray roz main takdi rehndi her thaa’n sub nu labdi rehndi
Bhain Sakina nu aay akhee ohday kol tay maa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Khaimeya wich agg lagdi waikhi jigar teray wich barchi waikhi
Khaab daranday her pal veeran khoon da aay sehra.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Babay nu Sughra bhul gae aay laadli dhee vi Kya bhul gae aay
Baba baba ker Kay rondi aa kay shakal wikha..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Qalam Batool da likh kay roya qatal Rasool da karbal hoya
Noha nahin aay bhain dukhi da likheya aay pursa..
